test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 21 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: What is the value of ({k}+(1)/(k))({k}-(1)/({k)})({k}²+(1)/({k)²})({k}⁴+(1)/({k)⁴})?
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Identify the iterative use of the identity (a + b)(a − b) = a² − b².

Each product doubles the power of the variables and keeps the − sign.

The sequence of powers is: 1 → 2 → 4 → 8.

The final simplified form will be the square of the highest power terms in the last pair with a minus sign.

**∴ The correct answer is k⁸ − 1/k⁸.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given Expression: (k + 1/k)(k − 1/k)(k² + 1/k²)(k⁴ + 1/k⁴)

Formula Used: (a + b)(a − b) = a² − b²

⇒ [(k + 1/k)(k − 1/k)] × (k² + 1/k²) × (k⁴ + 1/k⁴)

⇒ (k² − 1/k²) × (k² + 1/k²) × (k⁴ + 1/k⁴)

⇒ [(k² − 1/k²)(k² + 1/k²)] × (k⁴ + 1/k⁴)

⇒ (k⁴ − 1/k⁴) × (k⁴ + 1/k⁴)

⇒ (k⁴)² − (1/k⁴)²

⇒ k⁸ − 1/k⁸

**∴ The correct answer is k⁸ − 1/k⁸.**

**__Additional Information__**

Difference of Squares

The identity (a + b)(a − b) = a² − b² is fundamental for simplifying algebraic products involving conjugate pairs.

General Power Rule

For an expression of the form (x − y)(x + y)(x² + y²)(x⁴ + y⁴)...(x²ⁿ−¹ + y²ⁿ−¹), the simplified result is x²ⁿ − y²ⁿ.

Cubic Identities

Sum of cubes: (a + b)(a² − ab + b²) = a³ + b³ and Difference of cubes: (a − b)(a² + ab + b²) = a³ − b³.</p
